summary: U.S. Energy Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a Second Amendment to its existing credit agreement with Firstbank Southwest. The amendment increases the borrowing base from $10M to $20M, fixes the interest rate margin at 2.00% per annum, and suspends financial covenant testing until March 2027. The revolving credit facility matures May 31, 2029. This is a routine refinancing or amendment of existing credit facilities, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements are present.
